_comment: Copy to config/identity.json and fill in YOUR accounts. This file is the only place the engine learns whose messages it is reading. config/identity.json is gitignored — never commit it.
_slackAccounts: One entry per Slack workspace. `account` is the macOS Keychain account name you stored that workspace's xoxp- user token under (service: taiv-secretary-slack). The FIRST entry is the primary workspace.
_mailboxes: Every Gmail mailbox to poll. Each needs its own Google OAuth bundle in Keychain (service: taiv-secretary-token-google, account: the address).
_calendarMailbox: Which Google Calendar new events get booked on.
